name: hip-thruster-with-mini-band
instructions:
1. Wrap a mini band around your legs positioned just above your knee caps.
2. Assume a supine position with your back on the hip thruster, knees bent, and feet flat at roughly shoulder width apart.
3. Drive both feet into the platform and squeeze your glutes while bridging your hips up.
4. Lower your hips back to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
